name: windows-background-control
description: Experimental independent Windows input, scoped accessibility and a live floating preview.

interface.shortDescription: Background input with verified scope and a live preview.
interface.longDescription: Local Windows controller with an experimental x86/x64 virtual input engine, scoped accessibility, optional Zen companion and a live PiP. Compatibility and physical co-use remain explicit acceptance gates; system-wide macOS parity is unfinished.
defaultPrompt: Use BetterWinControl to select my existing Stremio tab, then switch to my YouTube video and pause it in the background. Show the live PiP and verify each result without taking over my mouse or keyboard.
